knowledge_point.title: Reducing a 2x2 Augmented Matrix to REF Using Gaussian Elimination

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 8 \\ -1 & -2 & 5\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system represented by the matrix.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 8 \\ -1 & -2 & 5\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+1\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & -1 & 13\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :=-1\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -13\end{array}\right].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y &=8 \\ y &=-13\end{aligned}\right.
$$

and we can apply back substitution. The final equation $y=-13$ tells us the value of $y.$ Substituting this value into the first equation, we get

$$
x+\left(-13\right)=8\,\Rightarrow\,x=8+13=21.
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=21$ and $y=-13.$

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 6 & -24\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form using the standard algorithm for Gaussian elimination, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 6 & -24\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1} & :=-1\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & -1 \\ 5 & 6 & -24\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-5\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 16 & -19\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{16}\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{19}{16}\end{array}\right].\end{aligned}
$$
